---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    week = readr::parse_number(week),
    rank = as.numeric(rank)
  ) |>
  filter(artist %in% head(unique(artist), 8))

artists <- billboard_long |>
  distinct(artist) |>
  pull(artist)

artist_palette <- c(
  "#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99", "#117733",
  "#999933", "#DDCC77", "#CC6677", "#882255"
)
artist_colors <- stats::setNames(artist_palette[seq_along(artists)], artists)

chart <- ggplot(billboard_long, aes(x = week, y = rank, color = artist, group = track)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.05, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_width(10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = c(1, seq(10, 100, by = 10)),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = artist_colors, breaks = artists) +
  labs(
    x = "Week on chart",
    y = "Billboard Hot 100 rank (1 = highest)",
    title = "A song's journey on the Billboard Hot 100",
    subtitle = "Weekly chart positions for eight artists"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "#172B4D"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "#65758B"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EDF1F5", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#DCE3EA", linewidth = 0.45),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#425466"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#526174"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 4, 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

legend_items <- purrr::map2(
  artists,
  unname(artist_colors),
  \(artist, color) htmltools::div(
    class = "billboard-legend-item",
    htmltools::span(
      class = "billboard-legend-swatch",
      style = paste0("background-color: ", color)
    ),
    htmltools::span(artist)
  )
)

htmltools::div(
  class = "billboard-page",
  plotly::ggplotly(chart, tooltip = c("artist", "week", "rank")) |>
    plotly::layout(
      autosize = TRUE,
      showlegend = FALSE,
      font = list(
        family = "system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif",
        color = "#425466"
      ),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      margin = list(l = 72, r = 18, t = 66, b = 58)
    ) |>
    plotly::config(displayModeBar = FALSE, responsive = TRUE),
  htmltools::div(
    class = "billboard-legend",
    htmltools::tagList(legend_items)
  )
)
```
